**Files:** Several `.worker.js` bundles under `.antigravity-ide/extensions/ms-python.python-2026.4.0-universal/out/client/`

```js
t.AppinsightsKey="0c6ae279ed8443289764825290e4f9e2-1a736e7c-1324-4338-be46-fc2a58ae4d14-7255"
```

This is a **live Application Insights instrumentation key** hardcoded into the minified worker bundles. Application Insights keys grant anyone who possesses them the ability to **ingest telemetry data** into the associated Azure Application Insights resource — and depending on the resource configuration, can allow querying or exfiltration of stored telemetry (which may contain user PII, error details, file paths, and usage patterns from every VS Code user who has this extension installed).

**File:** `.9router/runtime/mitm/server.js`

1. Generates its own **self-signed root CA certificate** (line ~52)
